notes: Four source-named shell monolayers; sequence is ordered from CdSe core outward.
Only the first core aliquot is quantified; repeated half-reaction step volumes are from the general c-ALD protocol.
Figure 1 band edges are bulk-level schematics, not measured nanoparticle coordinates.
Figure 3B caption assigns this composition but adjacent prose calls it 4.5 nm CdSe/CdS4. No measured 4.5 nm size or panel B TEM is bound to this recipe pending conflict resolution.
Table 1 #ML=4 PL spectral FWHM is 0.13 eV for the /ZnS/CdS3 column; it is an optical size-dispersion proxy, not physical diameter.
